Case Study: Anonymised — Manufacturing Sector

Challenge: A mid-size manufacturing facility was experiencing an average of 14 hours of unplanned machine downtime per month across its production lines. The root cause was almost always predictable — bearing wear, motor temperature drift, or pneumatic pressure loss — but without real-time sensor data, failures were only discovered when machines stopped. Maintenance was reactive and expensive, with emergency call-outs costing 3–5x more than scheduled servicing.

Solution: AICORE deployed a network of vibration, temperature, and pressure sensors on the eight highest-criticality machines. Sensor data was transmitted via MQTT to a cloud ingestion pipeline, stored in InfluxDB, and surfaced through a custom monitoring dashboard. An anomaly detection layer established baselines for each machine's sensor signatures and generated alerts when readings deviated beyond defined thresholds. Maintenance teams received WhatsApp and email alerts with the specific machine, sensor, and deviation magnitude — enabling targeted inspection before failure occurred.

Outcomes: 40% reduction in unplanned downtime within 90 days of deployment Emergency maintenance call-outs reduced from 12 to 4 per quarter Maintenance cost per machine reduced by 28% through scheduled intervention Dashboard visibility adopted by production managers for daily shift planning

Technologies: ESP32 sensors, MQTT, InfluxDB, Python, React dashboard, WhatsApp API.
